Casar argues data center projects should be blocked if they raise electricity bills or otherwise harm the communities where they’re built. He discusses legislation that would impose a tax on large AI companies and increase the rate as unemployment rises, with revenue used to support a federal jobs program. Rep. Casar also says Democrats should focus on working people and argues Republican efforts to label Democrats communists are a familiar political tactic that won’t work. Flood also says the US needs to "finish the job" in Iran while putting the mental health, safety and morale of American service members at the highest level of concern. She also says Francesca Hong's strong showing in Wisconsin's Democratic gubernatorial primary demonstrated the resonance of her affordability message, while arguing Democrats shouldn't be bullied by Republican efforts to characterize safety-net policies as communism.
